notes: TEST BUILD — PR #19 (stacked on #18 and #17), pushed to the updater at Michael's request. Controls anywhere gains a Slices editor: reorder the pie's slices, remove the ones you don't use, add them back — the last slice can't be removed, and an empty set falls back to all four. Your slice set and the new opening-speed setting (Standard, Fast, Instant) apply to both the overlay pie and the Home pie. Also new: drag in and slide back to the edge to cancel the pie instead of firing; a plain tap still parks it. Everything from 0.18.3 is included.
